dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: I know, I know, the name sounds a little odd.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: But Zhongyuan Chop Suey is a local specialty here in Chihu Rock.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: It all starts with rinsed giblets that are chopped into mince meat. Then you add some Tiger Fish gelatin along with some starch and other ingredients, and roll it into meatballs.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: After a quick deep fry, they're ready to be enjoyed. Not a hint of fish in that wonderful aroma!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: But it sure is troublesome having to explain the name to every outlander that shows up to eat here, whew!
